diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says Vo, datasheet reading says VCC
diffs.evidence: Sharp GP2Y0A41SK0F datasheet (Sheet No. OP13008EN), page 2 'Outline' drawing CY13036j02A, 'Connector signal' table: (1) Vo, (2) GND, (3) Vcc; connector JCTC 12001W90-3P-HF with pins marked 1-2-3 on the drawing. The second reading listed the pins in arbitrary order (VCC, GND, VO) rather than by connector number; pin 1 is Vo.

diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says VCC, datasheet reading says VO
diffs.evidence: Sharp GP2Y0A41SK0F datasheet (Sheet No. OP13008EN), page 2 'Outline' drawing CY13036j02A, 'Connector signal' table: (1) Vo, (2) GND, (3) Vcc. Pin 3 is Vcc, as the model says; the same Pololu-hosted copy of the datasheet (pololu.com/file/0J713) is identical.
